prompts: Create fx-shadowburst.png for Riley Wheel Brawl 2.0. OUTPUT: exactly 1536x256 PNG, genuinely transparent background, real alpha, no text/borders. SIX equal cells of 256x256 in one row, left to right, an animation of a BURST OF INKY BLACK SHADOW SMOKE (when a shadow copy is struck and pops): 1: a tight dark core with a violet flash at the centre, 2: billowing outward, 3: a full round cloud of curling black-purple smoke puffs, 4: breaking apart into separate curls, 5: thin wisps drifting outward and upward, 6: a few last fading wisps. Painted smoke with clean dark outlines and 2-3 cel-shaded purple-black tones, NOT a blur or airbrush. Hand-drawn HD 2D game art in the spirit of Streets of Rage 4. Kid-friendly.

Using the attached image only as a style reference for the painting technique and dusk colours (do not draw any buildings or characters from it), create ONE landscape image (3:2): a sprite collage of magical shadow-smoke effects for a hand-drawn 2D side-scrolling game, on a perfectly flat, pure chroma-key green background (#00FF00) that fills the whole canvas edge to edge.

LAYOUT: three rows, ten separate elements in total, evenly spaced. Each element is centred in its own slot with plenty of empty green around it. Nothing touches another element or the edge of the canvas. No text, no numbers, no labels, no borders, no grid lines, no floor, no cast shadows.

ROW 1 (top) - SHADOW POOL ON THE GROUND, 4 frames, left to right. A magical pool of inky black shadow lying flat on the ground, seen from a low side-on game camera, so it is a wide flat ellipse about four times wider than it is tall. All four pools have the same width and the same ellipse outline; only the activity inside them grows. Frame 1: a still, glossy black pool with a faint dark-violet sheen. Frame 2: slow ripples swirling across its surface. Frame 3: a swirling inky surface with a thin glowing violet rim. Frame 4: churning, with a few thin black wisps curling up from the rim, no taller than half the pool's width.

ROWS 2 AND 3 - SHADOW SMOKE PUFF, 6 frames of one short animation (row 2 = frames 1-3, row 3 = frames 4-6): a shadowy double vanishing in a puff of black smoke. Frame 1: a dense ball of black smoke, already about half the size of frame 3, with a small bright violet flash at its centre. Frame 2: billowing outward into a larger rounded cloud, the violet flash fading. Frame 3: a full round cloud of curling black and charcoal smoke puffs, the biggest frame. Frame 4: the cloud breaking apart into separate curls with gaps between them. Frame 5: thin wisps drifting outward and upward. Frame 6: a few last small wisps. All six frames are drawn at the same scale and centred on the same point, so they play as one smooth animation.

STYLE: the smoke is painted, not airbrushed: solid cel-shaded shapes with confident dark outlines and 2-3 tone steps of black, deep charcoal-blue and dark violet, like smoke effects in Streets of Rage 4 or a hand-drawn animated film. Opaque painted shapes: no soft glow, no blur, no see-through haze, no gradients fading into the background. No green anywhere in the effects, so the background can be cut out cleanly. Spooky, not gory.
